title: Pokémon TCG Annihilape Scarlet & Violet Base Set 109/198 Holo Holo Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Pokémon TCG card is a must-have for any collector or player. The Annihilape card from the Scarlet & Violet Base Set features a powerful Fighting type with 140 HP and a Stage 2 evolution. This Holo Rare card has a stunning holo finish that is sure to impress.

With the card number 109/198, this Pokémon card is a valuable addition to any collection. It is perfect for battling against opponents or displaying alongside your other collectibles. Don't miss out on the chance to add this rare and powerful card to your collection today.
